source_segments.text: was spotted by a scout and invited for an initial two-week trial with English club Manchester United.
The trial was extended to a month and Ryan signed as an apprentice with the club on 7 December 1962.

A month later, he signed his first professional contract, but it was not until May 1966 that he made his first-team debut, playing on the right wing in the final four league games of the 1965–66 season.
He scored his first goal in the third of those games, the third goal in a 6–1 home win over Aston Villa.
